- Ingxenye ngaphezu kuka-8,000만원: 30%
Intela iyisamba sezintela kula ngxenye amathathu, futhi umholo ngemva kwentela umholo kususwe intela. U-Seoyun uxazulule ethi, 'Uma udlula u-4,000만원 izinga liba ngu-20%, ngakho ngempela uyalahlekelwa.'

y-m-72-07.title: Kwenzekani Ezindlini Zokudla Uma Wenza Amabhokisi Amaningi?
y-m-72-07.topic: Izindleko zesilinganiso nezindleko ezengeziwe (imikhawulo yezomnotho wesikali)
y-m-72-07.goal: Phula ngesibonelo esiphikisayo isimangalo esandise umthetho obonwe ethebuleni waya ebubanzini obungahloliwe, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani isilinganiso siyakhuphuka futhi siyehle ngokuqhathanisa 'izindleko zokwenza elilodwa elengeziwe' nesilinganiso.
y-m-72-07.material:
Uma imboni yamabhokisi okudla yenza amabhokisi angu-q ngosuku (q iyinombolo ephelele engu-1 noma ngaphezulu), izindleko eziphelele zansuku zonke zingu-C(q) = q² + 4q + 100 (man won). U-100 uyizindleko ezimiswe ezivela noma yingaki amabhokisi enziwe, futhi q²+4q izinto zokusebenza nabasebenzi. Izindleko zebhokisi ngalinye zichazwa njengo-C(q) ÷ q (man won). (Ifundwa: C ka-q ilingana no-q squared kanye no-4 q kanye no-100.) Ngezansi kunamanani ambalwa.
q=2: 56 / q=4: 33 / q=6: cishe 26.7 / q=8: 24.5
Umphathi wemboni uthi, 'Uma sikhiqiza kakhulu, izindleko zebhokisi ngalinye ziyancipha, ngakho ake sikhiqize ngangokunokwenzeka.'
y-m-72-07.thinking.0: Ukuhlola isiphetho esijwayelekile esidlula ububanzi obuhloliwe
y-m-72-07.prereq.0: (Umcabango wesabelo) I-'Economic Mathematics' ithathwa njengesifundo sokukhetha sesikole esiphakeme esikhethwa ngemva kokufunda izisekelo zezinombolo, izisho nemisebenzi. I-H1/H2 izimpawu zezinga lobunzima nokusekelwa kwalesi sabelo sokukhiqiza kuphela; azisho ukuthi uMnyango Wezemfundo unikeza lesi sifundo ebangeni elithile. Ulwazi lokufaka amanani esishweni se-quadratic nokusebenza ngo-C(q)÷q (ukubala izisho cishe ezingeni lezibalo zesikole esiphakeme). I-calculus ayisetshenziswa. Lo msebenzi uphezulu isinyathelo esisodwa kunobunzima bokwethula.

y-m-72-12.title: Ithebula Lenzuzo Yezitolo Ezimbili Ezibeka Izintengo
y-m-72-12.topic: Ukuncintisana kwentengo phakathi kwezitolo ezimbili (ukufunda nokuklama ithebula lenzuzo)
y-m-72-12.goal: Qinisekisa ngethebula lenzuzo ukuthi noma ukukhetha okukodwa kungcono noma omunye enzani, uma bobabili bekwenza ndawonye kungaba kubi kubo bonke, klama ngokwakho ithebula lenzuzo lesakhiwo esifanayo, bese usho ukuthi izinto ziguquka kanjani uma kuphindwa, ngezimo.
y-m-72-12.material:
Isitolo sokudla okulula u-X nesitolo sokudla okulula u-Y sisesitaladini esifanayo, futhi isonto elilodwa ngasinye singakwazi 'ukugcina' noma 'ukwehlisa' intengo yaso. Izitolo ezimbili zinquma ngesikhathi esisodwa futhi azazi ukukhetha komunye. (Ukuvumelana ngezintengo kusengaphambili (ukuhlanganyela) kuvame ukuvinjelwa umthetho, ngakho akumbozwa kulo msebenzi.) Izinzuzo zesonto elilodwa (만원; ukulandelana kuyinzuzo luka-X, inzuzo luka-Y) zilandelayo.
U-X ugcina · u-Y ugcina: (60, 60)
U-X wehlisa · u-Y ugcina: (80, 30)
U-X ugcina · u-Y wehlisa: (30, 80)
U-X wehlisa · u-Y wehlisa: (40, 40)
(Funda: uma u-X wehlisa futhi u-Y egcina, u-X uthola u-80만원 no-Y athole u-30만원.)
y-m-72-12.thinking.0: Ukufunda ithebula nokuqhathanisa ngokukhetha ngakunye komunye
y-m-72-12.thinking.1: Ukwenza isibonelo sesakhiwo esifanayo ngaphansi kwemikhawulo
y-m-72-12.thinking.2: Ukuchaza umehluko phakathi kwesimo sesikhathi esisodwa nesiphindaphindwayo ngezimo
y-m-72-12.prereq.0: (Umcabango womsebenzi) 'Economic Mathematics' kucatshangwa ukuthi isifundo esikhethiwe sesikole esiphakeme sikhethwa ngemva kokufunda izisekelo zezinombolo, izisho nemisebenzi. I-H1/H2 amalebula obunzima nezinga losizo kuphela alo msebenzi wokukhiqiza; akusho ukuthi uMnyango Wezemfundo wabela isifundo ibanga elithile. Isipiliyoni sokufunda ithebula, ukuqhathanisa usayizi nokuhlola izimo zokungalingani (cishe izibalo zesikole esiphakeme). Lo msebenzi uyisinyathelo esisodwa ngenhla kobunzima bokuqala.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.prompt: Cabanga ngombono wesitolo u-X. Noma yisiphi isitolo u-Y esikhethayo (ukugcina noma ukunciphisa), iyiphi inketho engcono ku-X?
y-m-72-12.s.s1.hint.0: Uma u-Y egcina, thola amanani amabili enzuzo ka-X etafuleni bese uwaqhathanisa.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.hint.1: Thola futhi amanani amabili enzuzo ka-X uma u-Y enciphisa bese uwaqhathanisa, futhi uhlole ukuthi imiphumela yokuqhathanisa okubili iyafana yini.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.o.a: Uma u-Y egcina intengo yakhe, ukunciphisa kungcono, futhi uma u-Y enciphisa, ukugcina kungcono.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.r.a: Uma u-Y enciphisa, u-X uthola u-30 uma egcina futhi u-40 uma enciphisa. Funda leli cala etafuleni futhi.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.o.b: Ukunciphisa kungcono noma ngabe u-Y ukhetha ini. Kuwo wonke amacala inzuzo yokunciphisa inkulu.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.r.b: Uma u-Y egcina, ukunciphisa kuka-X kunikeza u-80, okungaphezu kuka-60 wokugcina, futhi uma u-Y enciphisa, ukunciphisa kuka-X kunikeza u-40, okungaphezu kuka-30 wokugcina.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.o.c: Ukugcina kungcono noma ngabe u-Y ukhetha ini. Uma bobabili begcina, ngu-60, okukhulu kunakho konke.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.r.c: U-60 lapho bobabili begcina yilokho u-X no-Y abakuthola ndawonye. Uma u-Y enciphisa, u-X angathola u-30 kuphela ngokugcina.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.o.d: Ithebula lodwa alikwazi ukusitshela ukuthi kuncike ekukhetheni kuka-Y yini.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.r.d: Uma ufunda ithebula ngokuhlukanisa ukukhetha kuka-Y emacaleni amabili, ungabona kuwo ngamunye ukuthi iyiphi inketho enikeza u-X inzuzo enkulu.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.explain: Uma u-Y egcina, ukunciphisa kuka-X (80) kukhulu kunokugcina (60), futhi uma u-Y enciphisa, ukunciphisa kuka-X (40) kukhulu kunokugcina (30). Noma u-Y enzani, ukunciphisa kungcono, ngakho u-X ufuna ukukhetha ukunciphisa. U-Y unesakhiwo esifanayo, ngakho uma bobabili bencipha kungu-(40, 40), noma ukugcina kwabo bobabili kunikeze u-(60, 60) omkhulu.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.prompt: Yenza wena enye ithebula le-payoff elinesakhiwo esifanayo nesingenhla. T yinzuzo ka-X uma u-X kuphela encipha, R uma bobabili begcina, P uma bobabili bencipha, no-S uma u-X kuphela egcina (u-Y kuphela encipha). Ukugcina isakhiwo sendaba, T > R > P > S kumele kusebenze, futhi isamba senzuzo nelahleko yokunciphisa uhlangothi olulodwa kuphela (T+S) kumele sibe sincane kunamaphesenti amabili enzuzo yokugcina kwabo bobabili (2R). Yenza amasethi amabili ahlukene wamanani amane ahlukile ethebuleni elingenhla. (Izinombolo eziqondile kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-100)
y-m-72-12.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale ukulandelana kosayizi bezinombolo ezine ethebuleni elingenhla.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.hint.1: Shintsha izinombolo ugcine ukulandelana, bese uhlola isimo sokugcina (2R uma kuqhathaniswa no-T+S) ngokukubala wena.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.var.T: Inzuzo ka-X uma u-X kuphela encipha (T)
y-m-72-12.s.s2.var.S: Inzuzo ka-X uma u-X kuphela egcina (S)
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c1: Amanani amane ayizinombolo eziqondile kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-100.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c1: Sicela wenze amanani amane abe yizinombolo eziqondile kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-100.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c2: Inzuzo T yokunciphisa wedwa inkulu kuno-R yokugcina kwabo bobabili.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c2: T ayinkulu kuno-R. Uma omunye egcina, ukunciphisa kumele kube nenzuzo enkulu.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c3: Ukugcina kwabo bobabili (R) kukhulu kunokunciphisa kwabo bobabili (P).
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c3: R ayinkulu kuno-P. Uma bobabili bencipha, bobabili kumele babe sesimweni esibi kakhulu.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c4: Ukunciphisa kwabo bobabili (P) kukhulu kunokugcina wedwa (S).
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c4: P ayinkulu kuno-S. Uma omunye enciphisa, ukunciphisa kumele futhi kube nenzuzo enkulu.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c5: Isamba uma bobabili begcina (2R) sikhulu kunesamba uma omunye kuphela encipha (T+S).
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c5: 2R ayinkulu kuno-T+S. Isamba uma bobabili begcina kumele sibe sikhulu.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c6: Ziyizinombolo ezifanayo nethebula elingenhla. Yenza ngezinombolo ezihlukile.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.explain: Uma T>R>P>S njengo-(70, 50, 20, 10) futhi 2R=100 inkulu kuno-T+S=80, isakhiwo sendaba siyafana. Kulesi sakhiwo isitolo ngasinye sinenzuzo ngokukhetha ukunciphisa, kodwa uma bobabili bencipha, inzuzo incane kunalapho bobabili bebegcinile.
y-m-72-12.s.s3.prompt: Uma lezi zitolo ezimbili zingqubuzana hhayi kanye kuphela kodwa zihlale zingqubuzana njalo ngeviki, isiphetho singashintsha? Bhala, ngezizathu, ukuthi ngaphansi kwezimo ezinjani singashintsha nokuthi kanjani (noma ukuthi ngeke sishintshe).
y-m-72-12.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi ukukhetha kwakho kuleli viki kungashintsha yini uma ufunda ukuthi esinye isitolo sincipha ngeviki eledlule.
y-m-72-12.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi 'omunye uzophendula kanjani uma nginciphisa?' kuhluke kanjani phakathi kokuncintisana kanye nokuqhubeka nokuncintisana.
y-m-72-12.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ngicabange ukuthi uma kuphindwa unganquma ngokubheka ukukhetha kwangaphambilini komunye?
y-m-72-12.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ngibhale ngokukhonkolo izimo ezingashintsha ngaphansi kwazo isiphetho (impendulo yomunye, ukwethembana njalonjalo)?
y-m-72-12.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ngicabange ukuthi kungaba khona amacala lapho singashintshi (njengalapho iviki lokugcina lilungisiwe)?
y-m-72-12.s.s3.model.0: Uma beqhubeka nokuncintisana njalo ngeviki, bangabheka ukuthi omunye wanciphisa ngeviki eledlule yini bese bencipha ndawonye ngokulandelayo, ngakho bobabili ukugcina kungaqhubeka, noma ukunciphisa kwabo bobabili kungaba okungashintshi. Ngakho isiphetho singashintsha kuye ngempendulo yomunye.
y-m-72-12.s.s3.model.1: Uma kuyikanye kuphela, ukunciphisa kungcono, kodwa uma kuphindwa amaviki amaningi omunye angaziphindisela futhi inzuzo ingehla, ngakho ungakhetha ukugcina. Nokho, uma bobabili bazi ukuthi iviki lokugcina lilungisiwe, bazonciphisa ngeviki lokugcina, ngakho isiphetho singashintsha futhi.
y-m-72-12.s.s3.model.2: Uma behlangana izikhathi eziningi, ukwethembana kuyakhula, futhi uma nginciphisa, omunye angancipha naye, ngakho ukugcina intengo kungaba nenzuzo enkulu.
